# OMP007 `mpi-in-threaded-region-without-thread-support`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

MPI is called inside an OpenMP parallel region but initialised with `mpi_init`, not `mpi_init_thread`.

## Why

`mpi_init` provides the `MPI_THREAD_SINGLE` level: only one thread may exist, let alone call MPI.
MPI calls made by threads of a parallel region (even in `master`/`single`) need
`mpi_init_thread` requesting `MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED`, `SERIALIZED` or `MULTIPLE`, and a check of the
level actually provided. Reported only when the project calls `mpi_init` and never
`mpi_init_thread`.

## Reported

```fortran
call mpi_init(ierr)
...
!$omp parallel
call mpi_send(buf, n, MPI_REAL, dest, tag, comm, ierr)
!$omp end parallel
```

## Preferred

```fortran
call mpi_init_thread(MPI_THREAD_MULTIPLE, provided, ierr)
if (provided < MPI_THREAD_MULTIPLE) error stop 'MPI thread level'
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OMP007] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OMP007` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).
